prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 主流旗舰手机屏幕与价格参数 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "型号" spans 1 col × 2 row; "屏幕" spans 2 col × 1 row; "价格" spans 1 col × 2 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "型号" · longest unbreakable word 50px · one-line width 155px
  col 2: header "屏幕 › 尺寸" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 66px
  col 3: header "屏幕 › 技术" · longest unbreakable word 78px · one-line width 486px
  col 4: header "价格" · longest unbreakable word 38px · one-line width 72px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 720px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 719px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"比较六款旗舰手机的屏幕尺寸、显示技术与价格，帮助读者权衡选购。","reading":"读者先按型号定位，再横向查看该机的尺寸、技术和价格；也会纵向比较各机型的尺寸和价格。技术列信息密集，需要在换行后仍能清楚地对应所属型号。","groups":["尺寸和技术同属“屏幕”组：尺寸适合快速比较，技术提供较长的规格说明。","型号是行标识，价格是独立的比较指标；两者分别位于每行两端，共同帮助读者定位和判断。"],"keep_intact":["型号名称及其中的数字、字母和版本标识","屏幕尺寸数值及单位","价格数值及货币单位","技术名称、刷新率范围和亮度等规格中的数字与单位"],"may_wrap":["屏幕技术说明可在逗号或不同规格之间自然换行。","技术说明造成的行高可容纳同一行中较长型号的换行，但应尽量避免拆散型号标识。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [176, 87, 368, 88] · table 720×431px · row heights [36, 36, 60, 60, 60, 60, 60, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [168, 87, 376, 88] · table 720×431px · row heights [36, 36, 60, 60, 60, 60, 60, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [176, 89, 360, 94] · table 720×431px · row heights [36, 36, 60, 60, 60, 60, 60, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"型号与尺寸均保持单行，屏幕技术分两行呈现，行与行的对应关系清楚。","problems":"每个价格的“起”都单独落到第二行，削弱了价格作为整体的可读性，也使右侧重复出现零散的短行。","cause":"价格列宽88px，扣除内边距和边框后只有67px，容不下约72px的完整价格。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"技术列较宽，部分规格有更从容的换行空间；尺寸列仍便于纵向比较。","problems":"三星型号的“Ultra”被挤到下一行，价格的“起”也全部另起一行；增加的技术列宽度没有减少任何数据行的高度。","cause":"型号列168px不足以容纳最长型号的155px单行内容及21px内边距和边框；价格列88px也不足以容纳完整价格。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"型号、尺寸和完整价格均保持单行，价格列纵向比较尤其清楚；技术说明占两行，整体行高和节奏一致。","problems":"技术列相对紧张，部分中文规格在词组中间换行，例如“第二代”和“刷新”，阅读稍有停顿。","cause":"技术列360px，扣除21px后可用339px；尺寸列89px和价格列94px各有少量可回收空间。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"r2A","widths":[176,87,363,93],"change":"以r1C为基础，将尺寸列缩窄2px、价格列缩窄1px，全部转给技术列。型号、尺寸和价格仍有各自所需的单行宽度，技术说明获得少量额外空间，可检查是否改善词组换行。"}]}
